label: H.R. 1041
title: Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act

items.snippet: This bill prohibits the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) from transmitting certain information to the National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS) utilized by licensed importers or dealers of firearms.
